repairs.quote: Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional (3/3.5/4/4.5/5% + (3.5% per 100 Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target. The percent Health damage does a minimum of 20/30/40/50/60. Against jungle monsters the damage is capped at 300. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
